csv_scope_of_work: The City of Hopkins is seeking a qualified consultant team ( Consultant ) to develop a comprehensive parking demand and management strategy ( Plan ). The Plan will serve as an implementation document used to guide parking policies and regulations for present and future growth around Downtown Hopkins. The selected Consultant will be responsible for engaging with residents, business owners, staff, elected officials, experts and users on parking management and operations to develop a Plan that reflects the community s opportunities and needs.
